purpose: Identify an official Anqing city-level real-estate registration institution and resolve the prior unresolved local-custody assessment.
assessment: Confirmed city-level custody evidence. Anqing Municipal Org Work Committee’s government-hosted portal publishes an article authored by the Anqing Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. It explicitly names “安庆市自然资源和规划局不动产登记中心” (Anqing Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau Real Estate Registration Center) and describes that center carrying out a local land-registration case with the Yixiu District People’s Court. A second city procurement-platform result independently names 安庆市不动产登记中心 as the buyer for digitizing its registration archives. City-local registry custody is therefore supported; neither source provides parcel-vector geometry.
registryBasis: The city-hosted municipal-organ-affairs page, authored by the Anqing Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, directly names its real-estate registration center and describes it performing land-registration work.
